main_body: Beehive-shaped thatched hut: a large conical straw roof dome (rows 2-56) over a clay wall with an arched doorway (rows 57-77) and a stone base strip
top_band: Thatch roof slope in tan/gold, L 124-186, in layered bands from row 2 down to the eave at about row 55. The wide eave overhang at row 54 extends past the walls.
evidence: The big thatched roof reads as a sloped surface seen from above, and it is clearly separated from the vertical clay wall by the dark eave line at row 54. Rows 56-60 under the eave are shaded dark, so the overhang casts a shadow on the wall. The doorway is inset, with a lighter lintel and a dark inner opening, and it sits under the thatch arch. This matches the roof-plus-wall structure of the house references. No receding side faces are drawn.

style.evidence: The thatch has about 6 lightness steps. It has per-bundle highlights and dark course lines, and it reads as hand-shaded straw. The outline is a dark brown tinted to the thatch and wall, and only 7% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, which matches the references. The clay wall carries grain streaks and a gradient, and the stone base is speckled. Colour counts are lower than the references: 8 per tile against 11-18, and 31 distinct colours against 66-185. Flat-fill coverage is 12%, mostly the dark doorway interior. This is a lean, limited palette, but it is not a sticker look and would sit acceptably next to the references.
